description: DeST is a simulation platform for the built environment and HVAC systems, based on more than ten years of research at the Institute of Environment and Equipment of Tsinghua University's Department of Building Science, according to its website (read in Chinese). It applies its own simulation approach to the thermal environment of buildings and to HVAC systems, supporting research, prediction and performance evaluation of building environments and the design and optimisation of HVAC systems. Two versions exist: DeST-h for residential buildings and DeST-c for commercial buildings. The site also has a download centre, engineering application examples and notices of training certificates. Coverage: developed for Chinese buildings and widely used in China. Access: through the DeST website. Licence and cost: not stated on the text read. Caveats: the site serves its text through scripts, so details were read from the page script; the interface and documentation are mainly in Chinese. Simulation uses: building load and HVAC system simulation for design, energy codes and retrofit studies in China. Related records: EnergyPlus and the BuildSysPro Modelica library.
